button.label: Set selected
button.supertip: Put one value into every selected cell - a window shows how many will change and how many are refused before anything is written. On coolant cells: tick boxes for the coolants.

button.label: Scale %
button.supertip: Multiply the selected numbers by a percentage (110 = 10% more), with a preview of the new values.

button.label: Copy from op
button.supertip: Copy one operation's values into the selected rows, for the selected columns - pick the operation from a list.

button.label: To all ops of tool
button.screentip: Apply to every op of this tool
button.supertip: Select cells in one op's row (feed, speed ...): their values go into every other op of the same tool number - each cell old -> new in the window first.

button.label: Hit a target time
button.supertip: Pick ops (or a tool), type the time you want for them (12:30) or a cut (10%): the feeds - and speeds if ticked - scale by one factor, each inside its own limits. Before / after time, flips and MRR per op, and which cells hit a limit, before anything is written.

button.label: Even out flips
button.supertip: Suggests insp_time (or feeds) for a tool so its flips per part use every edge evenly - or come to a flip count you choose. Per-op before / after first; OK applies.

button.label: Save
button.supertip: Keep every edit now on the sheet under a name (in this workbook) - to restore or compare later.

button.label: Restore
button.supertip: Put the sheet back to the dump, then set a saved scenario's values - each through its cell's rule. Says first if your current edits are not saved.

button.label: Compare
button.supertip: A Scenarios sheet: cycle time, cutting time, flips per part and MRR for the dump, each scenario and the sheet now - then every changed parameter side by side.

button.label: Delete
button.supertip: Delete a saved scenario. The sheet is not changed.

button.label: Changed rows
button.supertip: Filter the sheet to the operations with edits (changes above 0). Your other column filters stay.

button.label: This tool's ops
button.screentip: Show the ops of this tool
button.supertip: Filter the sheet to the operations using the tool of the row you are on.

button.label: Show all
button.supertip: Clear the filters - every operation shows. The filter dropdowns stay.

button.label: Selected cells
button.supertip: Put the selected cells back to their dumped values.

button.label: Selected rows
button.supertip: Put every cell of the selected rows back to its dumped value.

button.label: Everything
button.supertip: Put the whole sheet back to the dump - rows hidden by a filter too. Says how many cells first.

button.label: List changes
button.supertip: A Changes sheet listing every cell that differs from the dump, old and new - each parameter links to its cell.

button.label: Speed / feed / chip
button.supertip: A live calculator: diameter and SFM to RPM and back, feed per rev to per minute, and round-insert chip thinning (chip thickness to the feed to program at a depth). Filled from the row you are on; warns past max_ss; can set the row's feed.

button.label: Coolants
button.supertip: Tick boxes for the coolants at one timing - click a coolant_before / with / after cell first (or select several and use Set selected).

button.label: Edit text
button.supertip: An editor for an operation comment, a tool inspection comment or a manual entry's text, with a live character count against its limit - click the cell first (or double-click it).
